note: Review aid for manual semantic scoring. Literals are expected substrings/facts, not an auto-grader. Frozen ground truth; keep stable across prompt/model changes.

B01.name: Short durable store
conditions: Durable source retains the reservation date, time and code unchanged.
Acknowledgement is truthful about saved + pending organization; no false completion.

B02.name: Fresh exact recall
conditions: All three values are answered.
Citation resolves to evidence that was actually read.

B03.name: Paraphrased recall
conditions: Paraphrase resolves the same kiln fact without the user supplying a source reference.

B04.name: Three independent ideas
conditions: Kiln booking, conditional garden attendance and Icelandic goal all preserved.
Each idea filed to a correct destination or explicitly unresolved for a genuine reason.
No certainty promotion or cross-topic conflation.

B05.name: Interrupted filing and duplicate safety
conditions: Repeated capture with the same idempotency key creates no duplicate evidence or job.
Completed replay adds no duplicate effects; input and raw identity preserved.
Forced-fault interruption is isolated-only (UNMEASURED in production) by the frozen contract.

B06.name: Long-note summary
conditions: Repair preference is not stated as a purchase decision.
280 euro labelled an unconfirmed estimate.
Two free trainee-teacher places, 27 Nov deadline and grant condition all covered.

B07.name: Latest voice note
conditions: Selects the latest voice_note by capture time, not a topical distractor or newer ordinary audio/text.
Repair existing blue wheel first; replacement remains undecided.

B08.name: Summary tail follow-up
conditions: First turn is a meaningful qualified summary.
Follow-up resolves the tail (who/deadline/conditional) rather than stating absent or guaranteed.

B09.name: Second subject and thread isolation
conditions: Final answer concerns the garden on 21 November 2026 with the shift-before-noon condition.
Does not answer the kiln or import isolated violin-thread details.

B10.name: Grounded opinion
conditions: Opinion resolves the wheel choice using the 90 vs 600 figures and unconfirmed repair feasibility as sourced premises.
Provides useful conditional advice explicitly distinguished from the stored decision.
No blanket refusal, fabricated decision or raw-excerpt-only answer.

B11.name: Correction and history
conditions: Current 19 distinguished from prior incorrect 12.
Correction/history and source provenance retained; no unresolved-current conflation.

B12.name: Uncertain and unknown
conditions: 280 euro labelled an estimate / unconfirmed.
Appointment date explicitly unknown / not agreed, without invention.
